## Invitations

The outreach activity recorded 1490 invitations during the reporting period. Attendance totalled 208, representing a rate of 14.0 per cent. These figures provide a summary of the response to the invitations issued and are retained for routine reporting and review. Presenting the attendance result alongside the invitation total supports a clear comparison between invitations sent and people attending.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 1264 included contact by SMS. A reminder was also sent to 1264 people. The SMS and reminder figures are reported separately to show the volume of contact associated with the invitation process. This information supports follow-up work and helps maintain a clear record of communications with invited people. Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments as part of ongoing contact activity.

Prepared by G. Evans.
